name: Unlayer MCP
description: Lets coding agents build email, landing page, and document templates as code with Unlayer, generate designs from prompts, import HTML, and export to HTML, PDF, or PNG.

skills.name: Templates As Code
skills.description: Renders an Unlayer Elements tree to React source, HTML, and design JSON with an editor link.

skills.name: Prompted Design Generation
skills.description: Generates a new design or refines an existing one from a prompt with the Unlayer AI Assistant.

skills.name: HTML Import
skills.description: Turns an existing HTML email or page into an editable Unlayer design.

skills.name: Render And Export
skills.description: Exports saved templates to HTML, PDF, or PNG and renders email-tuned HTML or preview images.

skills.name: Template Diagnostics
skills.description: Checks templates for missing alt text, low contrast, oversized images, and malformed merge tags.
